United Airlines Experiences Temporary System Outage in the Wake of Nationwide Ground Stop

United Airlines has resolved a technology issue that delayed departing flights on Monday afternoon, three days after the Federal Aviation Administration issued a nationwide ground stop that has continued to impact flights around the country. United Airlines confirmed in a statement to TIME on Monday evening that there was a “technology issue that delayed flight departures” that had since been resolved.
